### **Client Backstory:**

**Occupation:** Former marketing executive (currently unemployed)
**Background:**
Daniel grew up in a high-achieving family where success was equated with self-worth. His father was a corporate lawyer, and his mother was a surgeon—both emotionally distant but highly critical. Daniel excelled in school and landed a prestigious job, but after years of burnout, he was laid off six months ago. His long-term relationship ended shortly after when his partner accused him of being "emotionally unavailable."

Since then, Daniel has struggled with severe depression and anxiety. He isolates himself, avoids social interactions, and spends most of his time ruminating on past failures. He has insomnia, poor appetite, and frequent panic attacks. He feels like a burden to his few remaining friends and believes he has no purpose.
